# Relationship Links

## Summary
The wire shape of linked cards. Each `linksTo`/`linksToMany` field
serializes under `relationships`, keyed by field name (indexed keys for
many):

```json
"relationships": {
  "account": { "links": { "self": "../Account/acme-industries" } },
  "linkedExamples.0": { "links": { "self": "../Theme/midnight-marker" } }
}
```

## Invariants
- `links.self` is the authoritative pointer — when both appear,
  `links.self` takes precedence over `data.id`; installers that trusted
  `data.id` have dropped files.
- A null relationship is `{ "links": { "self": null } }`, not an absent
  key.
- Links may be relative (resolved against the instance URL) or absolute.

## Example
The invoice card (`Invoice/inv-2026-018`) demonstrates this: its account
and owner links serialize exactly as shown above.

## Module
`runtime-common/card-document-shape.ts` — relationship shape; field kinds:
`https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` — exports `linksTo`, `linksToMany`.
